notes.title: 🛠 Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[p]🪲 Fixes:[/p][p]• The "Exit" button in the main menu is no longer affected by the settings animation.[/p][p]• Settings can now be opened and closed correctly.[/p][p]• Voiceover volume settings are now saved after exiting the menu.[/p][p]• The ability to jump on boxes on the last level has been removed (the model no longer "flies").[/p][p]• Fixed a bug with an open input line after pressing ESC.[/p][p]• Fixed the sound of footsteps - no longer plays when jumping and moving at the same time.[/p][p]• Several correct answer options have been added to the miners level

🎮 Improvements:[/p][p]• Jump has been completely removed for gameplay stability.[/p][p]• Fonts have been updated.[/p][p]• Full localization into Ukrainian has been implemented.

⚡️ We continue to work on the project and prepare new updates.[/p][p]If you notice bugs or have ideas, write in the discussions![/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes: [p]\[b]Hello everyone!\[/b] 👋 [/p][p]We have released the first small patch with fixes and improvements. [/p][p]Thanks for playing and sharing your feedback 💙[/p][p]🔧 \[b]Fixes:\[/b][/p][p]• Subtitle resolution fixed.[/p][p]• ESC no longer closes the input line.[/p][p]• You can now enter text again after exiting via ESC.[/p][p]• A bug with footstep sounds has been fixed - they no longer play in place when pressing W.[/p][p]• A crossword puzzle has been added to the TV at level 5.[/p][p]• The lighting has been adjusted at level 5, becoming slightly darker.[/p][p]• The visuals of the buttons have been fixed for convenience.[/p][p]🎵 \[b]Audio:\[/b][/p][p]•  A problem with background sound cutting off at level 4 has been fixed.[/p][p]🎮 \[b]Improvements:\[/b][/p][p]•  Game settings (sound) have been added.[/p][p]•  A new achievement "Completed the Games" has appeared on Steam 🎉[/p][p]⚡ We continue to work on the project and prepare new updates. If you notice any bugs or have any ideas, write in the discussions![/p]
